risks.risk: Valuation and Emotion are distinct construct families; one top-level core may hide incompatible mechanisms and measurements.
risks.current_action: keep provisional umbrella but force separate modules; test split in R2

risks.risk: Reinforcement learning/value updating and habit/context-response automaticity are distinct mechanisms.
risks.current_action: separate modules immediately; test top-level split in R2

risks.risk: Homophily, identification, liking, parasocial connection, credibility and trust are frequently correlated and may be conflated in influencer research.
risks.current_action: require competing-construct fields and mediation tests before creating strong edges

risks.risk: The classic arousal→sharing claim is not universal; recent preregistered replications failed for incidental physiological arousal.
risks.current_action: downgrade universal arousal edge; represent content emotion, incidental arousal and context separately

risks.risk: Attention is broader than capture; current v0.2 overweights salience/goal/history and underrepresents sustained attention, suppression and disengagement.
risks.current_action: expand candidate module map before neuron expansion

risks.risk: Curiosity can be confused with novelty seeking or uncertainty reduction and ignores information avoidance if modeled monotonically.
risks.current_action: add avoidance/cost and competing-drive module candidate

risks.risk: Perceived credibility can be raised by heuristic credentials even when the credential is not context-relevant.
risks.current_action: separate perceived credibility from calibrated accuracy/trust

risks.risk: PSI, PSR, familiarity, attachment and reciprocal relationship are not interchangeable.
risks.current_action: represent distinct connection modules and transport boundaries

risks.risk: Virality combines human sharing with network/platform amplification.
risks.current_action: keep mechanical diffusion as system-level exposure object, not psychological neuron
